baseline.verification: 已按当前源码核对能力；静态检查不代表运行时或多客户端兼容认证。
baseline.feature_origin: Includes the independent-theme and icon controls introduced in 1.1.3; current checkout labels the build beta.

notes: 基于源码与默认配置的能力快照，不是运行时兼容认证。
字段名单是核心校验器的共享白名单，不是所有类型均支持这些字段。
离线工具不执行 Bukkit、PAPI、交易、动作或着色器。
本 Skill 不要求修改 Java 或编译插件；不同版本须核对能力。

resource_rules.source_height_rule: effective_height % (display_size / 9) == 0; canvas-height 0 preserves source, 16..240; normalized width must also be at most 240 normalizes generated PNG with nearest-neighbor
resource_rules.metadata_note: pack.yml is CraftEngine content metadata, not pack.mcmeta. Compatibility declarations do not adapt shaders.
resource_rules.image_fragments: assets/images/*.yml in filename order, then assets/images.yml overrides
resource_rules.canvas_background: background-image with background-size (default 72) on a Canvas node; drawn before its content, not clickable
resource_rules.rectangular_images: size is display height, display width follows aspect ratio; image must fit its allocated box

diagnostics.limitations: inspect/trace/dryrun require a player. dryrun only reports compiled components, requirements and top-level action names; it does not execute or simulate all branches/transactions.

notes: product.* 需要有效 shop/product 上下文；商品列表对应 item.*。
列表中的 item 字段由具体数据源定义。
profile.* 来自在线目标玩家；输入/数据/函数参数按各自入口提供。
购物车 purchase.quantity 表示行数，不是单商品份数。

themes.skin_aliases: skin-aliases maps an alias to an existing skin in that theme
themes.fallback: theme local skin, then global skin; aliases must target local skins
themes.image_sizes: union of global canvas.image-sizes and every independent theme
themes.native_scope: Independent themes scope Canvas skins and Dialog backing; native button textures remain global.

quantity_rules.legacy_maximum: Fallback for missing quantity.max; conflicts are errors

state_rules.selection: ascending priority, first matching visible; hide component if no state matches
state_rules.merge: recursive object merge and whole-list replacement
state_rules.validation: validate each effective component variant within the renderer; do not sum mutually exclusive IDs or sizes

menu_directories.identity: explicit id is authoritative; otherwise the relative path is used
menu_directories.migration: bundled standard menu filenames are moved from the old root; custom demo-prefixed files are outside that filename set

shop_category_selection.combination: union of selected categories, then intersect with shop.search
shop_category_selection.empty_selection: empty list or blank string means no category filter; no category is highlighted
shop_category_selection.normalization: deduplicate valid IDs; absent or entirely invalid nonempty selection falls back to the first category
shop_category_selection.toggle: one if branch with list append/remove; no built-in list toggle operation
shop_category_selection.clear: shop.search empty, shop.sort empty, category [], page absolute 0
shop_category_selection.sort: single choice; price sorts the combined result; default is highlighted only when explicitly selected
shop_category_selection.implementation: ShopCategorySelection is required; older beta builds may not support category lists

resource_delivery.external_uuid: derived from the verified ZIP SHA-1; expected-pack-uuid applies only to CraftEngine
resource_delivery.hosting: external requires an uploaded HTTP(S) download URL; no automatic upload or embedded HTTP server
resource_delivery.empty_url: startup and generation work; downloading waits for a configured URL
resource_delivery.verification: the hosted bytes must match the verified local ZIP; keep fonts, shaders, overlays and build receipt
resource_delivery.native: requires a Dialog-capable client; does not preserve Canvas artwork

BasicTool.toggle: click: toggle only for persistent boolean settings; only thumb is clickable
BasicTool.inline_choices: Legacy 1..3; settings workspace uses ui_inline_max from cycle-max-options (2..4); Data.choices-menu selects the permission-checked picker
BasicTool.refresh: Poll existing intervals, redraw only changed page/navigation snapshots or callback renewal; original permission/privacy checks continue
BasicTool.visual_style: Bedrock gray panels, green selection, vanilla pixel icons; shared module tabs and sidebar
BasicTool.page_identity: self compares target and viewer UUID; hide own name and single-page counter, retain other-player subject
BasicTool.module_tabs: Original player commands basictool settings/stats/stock with original permissions and configured target engine

server_controlled_settings.behavior: Use the definition default before stored, scope or native values; hide in player menus; reject player writes
server_controlled_settings.provided_policy: display.sidebar=false; BasicTool scoreboards.yml enabled=false; no sidebar control or preview

BasicTool.settings_tools: No decorative display/chat/waveform diagrams; sound category provides an actual test notification sound button, gated by notification.sound

rank_card.requires: BasicTool adapter containing FutureUiRank; explicit ranked record selected through original menu
rank_card.behavior: Uses saved selected record, no extra database query; retains zero; no tier inferred from rating/win rate; missing values remain unavailable; cap differs from honorary leaderboard rank

settings_workspace.scope_selection: Inline workspace state; no separate menu
settings_workspace.reset: Two-click confirmation with inline cancel; non-global scope resets to common values
settings_workspace.reset_click: Read reset-click (shift_right in workspace; right in legacy)
settings_workspace.remember_position: Current online session; category, scope, filter and page
settings_workspace.inventory: 54 slots, 12 settings per page; direct toggle/cycle; picker only for longer options

FotiaCosmetic.selection: Ordinary menus read show-unowned (default false). Legendary opens the configured weapon list, then all skins with original icons and ownership labels. Only owned skins can be selected through the persistent service.
FotiaCosmetic.preview: External model snapshots with explicit unavailable states; missing models show a labeled default item icon. No real weapon creation is required for menu preview.
FotiaCosmetic.external_assets: plugins/FotiaCosmetic/futureui-preview.yml and previews/; user test models never ship in either plugin

return_action.legendary_skin_page: Returns to the legendary weapon list before any external return command.

visibility.legendary: Always show all skins with ownership labels; no locked barrier icon.

inventory_tab_states.material_alias: VANILLA only; conflicts with a different id are rejected

charts.series: list of label/value/display/skin or a typed variable reference
charts.missing_data: skip missing, invalid, negative or non-finite values; total zero displays empty-text
charts.dialog: plain textual summary; graphic charts require Canvas or an embedded display Canvas

readability.ring_percentage: First series / total, rounded to 1 decimal, trailing zero removed; text overrides
readability.legend_stride: 36, then 27 or 18 to fit available height

raster.value: Typed extension variable; no path, URL or Base64
raster.interaction: Optional actions with enabled/requirements in normal Canvas; forbidden in embedded Dialog Canvas
raster.rendering: Nearest-neighbor fit, non-overlapping row spans grouped by color to avoid repeated NBT styles; immutable pixels; provider I/O and model rendering asynchronous

canvas_interaction.focus_outline: Match known body width and 1px border geometry; independent of vertical origin; ceil GUI viewport and native left clamp
canvas_interaction.hover_fit: Native footer aware; avoid scrolling; account for ceiled GUI viewport and 20px container margin
canvas_interaction.encoding: Shared hover style and relative tile offsets; no repeated full coordinate per tile
